faq.title: Got Questions?
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know about scanner functionality, TACO scientific auditing, offline mode, and access plans.

items.q: How does the app analyze restrictions?
items.a: NutriLense AI checks the complete ingredients list and nutritional composition against your personal profile (lactose, gluten, high sodium for hypertension, hidden sugars for diabetics, or food allergies). Using computer vision with Gemini, it spots subtle derivatives, camouflaged additives, and cross-contamination warnings, displaying immediate red alerts for incompatibilities.

Yes, 100% grounded in science. Alongside AI computer vision, the app uses the Brazilian Food Composition Table — TACO (NEPA/UNICAMP 4th Edition) as a secondary reference. This allows auditing caloric density, macronutrient distribution (protein, carbs, and fats), and sodium levels against official biological food matrices.

items.q: Can I use the scanner offline?
items.a: Your history and previously scanned items work seamlessly without internet thanks to our Progressive Web App (PWA) architecture with Service Workers and persistent local caching. In supermarkets with weak cellular signals, you can consult all previously analyzed foods. For scanning new products, a brief connection is used for Gemini multimodal AI.

items.q: How do I cancel my subscription?
items.a: You can cancel anytime in 1 click with no red tape or cancellation fees. Billing is managed directly through secure Stripe infrastructure. When you cancel, you retain full access to your Pro or Plus benefits until the end of your billing cycle, returning to the free plan with no surprise charges.

items.q: Does the scanner work on any supermarket item?
items.a: Yes! NutriLense AI reads both nutrition label photos and standard EAN-13 barcodes on national and international goods. The AI categorizes the NOVA classification (1 to 4 processing levels), calculates the Nutri-Score (A to E), and flags harmful additives in seconds.

items.q: Do I need to download from Google Play or Apple App Store?
items.a: No app store download required! NutriLense AI is a compliant PWA: install directly from your browser (on Safari: Share → Add to Home Screen; on Chrome/Android: click 'Install App' at the top). It opens full screen like a native app.

items.q: Can I export PDF reports for my doctor or dietitian?
items.a: Yes! In the 'PDF Reports' tab, view weekly nutrient and calorie trends with interactive Recharts graphics and generate executive reports in one click for download or printing, perfect for medical and sports checkups.
